Text.Text: You have been down in the old test site, because I can smell the foundry on you. I am Teb Orrin. I buy what comes out of the Droid Foundry, and lately a great deal has been walking out by itself.
They are scorched but readable, and I do not like what they say. The order book holds thousands of units and the customer is blank. Here is your pay. Ask me how to stop that line.
You are back from the Foundry. Do you have the five Foundry Memory Cores for me to read?

Kesa Morn pays people to break the foundry's droids, and good for her. I want to know what those droids were told to build, and every unit on that line carries its build orders in a memory core. I need you to destroy droids in the Hutlar Droid Foundry and bring me five Foundry Memory Cores. Bring them back to me here and I will pay you.

Good. Destroy the droids in the Hutlar Droid Foundry and bring me five Foundry Memory Cores here at the Hutlar Outpost. Haulers, sentries, welders and war droids all carry them, but not every core survives.
A foundry that wakes up by itself is only a fault. A foundry that wakes up with new orders has a customer, and I would very much like to know which one this is.
Go to the Abandoned Outpost and through the cloning test site. Kesa Morn stands at the Foundry Access door. Tell her Teb sent you, and expect her to say something rude.
I still need five Foundry Memory Cores from the droids in the Hutlar Droid Foundry. Not every droid's core survives the fight. Bring all five back to me here.
Here is your pay. The line will not stay jammed, because something in the Core will notice and start repairs. Ask me about the Core when you are ready to finish this.
You are back, and Kesa sent word that the hum under her deck has stopped. Did you destroy two Smelter Hulks and two Forge Wardens?

You break the two machines it cannot work without. Smelter Hulks melt scrap in the Intake to feed the line, and Forge Wardens keep the Assembly Line in order. Lose two of each and the line jams for days. I need you to destroy two Smelter Hulks in the Intake and two Forge Wardens on the Assembly Line, then come back to me here.
Good. Destroy two Smelter Hulks in the Intake and two Forge Wardens on the Assembly Line of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost.
You will not need help. A Smelter Hulk is the size of a cargo lifter and it glows. A Forge Warden is the droid giving all the others their orders.
No, the line builds them as it needs them. If you do not see one, destroy the droids you do see and wait for the line to build another.
You still need to destroy two Smelter Hulks in the Foundry Intake and two Forge Wardens on the Assembly Line. Come back to me when all four are scrap.
That depends on what the cores say, so I cannot tell you yet. Bring me the five Foundry Memory Cores first.
It is the best scrap I will ever buy, and here is a good price for it. I also cut its plating down to fit an arm. Take this Foundry Breaker's Bracer. There will only ever be one.
You are back. I walked over to Kesa's door myself, and the deck plates are cold and quiet. Is the Foundry Overseer destroyed?

The Overseer is in there. It is the machine that woke the Foundry up, took the order, and has been filling it ever since. Everything else down there is only one of its tools. I need you to go into the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry and destroy the Foundry Overseer. Come back to me here when it is scrap.
Good. Destroy the Foundry Overseer in the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost. I have an idea for its plating.
Partly, because I am a scrap dealer. But I also live two hundred meters from a war droid factory, and I have read its order book.
You will face the worst droids the line can build, and then the Overseer itself. Go in with a strong group. I will buy whatever you cannot carry out.
You still need to destroy the Foundry Overseer. It is in the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry. Come back to me when it is scrap.
The machine that would repair the line comes next. You have to jam the line first, with two Smelter Hulks and two Forge Wardens destroyed.
Then the line has lost its sorter. Here is the bounty. I have bounties on the other two supervisors as well, if you want them.
You are back, and the haulers have been stacking scrap in the wrong bins all week. Is Sorter Prime destroyed?

Three of them are, because the line has built itself supervisors. The first is Sorter Prime, which decides what scrap becomes what droid. I will pay a bounty to have it broken. I need you to go to the Intake of the Hutlar Droid Foundry and destroy Sorter Prime, then come back to me here. You may sell me its parts afterward.
Good. Destroy Sorter Prime in the Intake of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost for the bounty.
It works in the Intake, among the haulers and sentries. It is not always on the floor. If it is missing, it is being serviced, so come back later.
You still need to destroy Sorter Prime. It is in the Intake of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, though it is not always on the line. Come back to me when it is scrap.
Then fewer units are coming off the line, and it will stay slower for a while. Here is the bounty, and you earned it.
You are back, and Kesa says half as many patrols are trying her door. Is Foreman RX-12 destroyed?

There is, and its name is Foreman RX-12. It sets the pace of the line, and the pace has been going up. With it on the floor the line turns out a unit every few minutes. I need you to go to the Assembly Line of the Hutlar Droid Foundry and destroy Foreman RX-12, then come back to me here for the bounty.
Good. Destroy Foreman RX-12 on the Assembly Line of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost for the bounty.
It works on the Assembly Line, with the defenders and riveters. Like Sorter Prime, it comes and goes, so check again later if it is not there.
You still need to destroy Foreman RX-12. It is on the Assembly Line of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, though it is not always on the line. Come back to me when it is scrap.
Then nobody is checking them anymore. Here is the bounty, and I pay it gladly. Flawed droids are something I can live next to.
You are back. A war droid walked out of the test site yesterday and its leg fell off. Is Inspector Q-0 destroyed?

There is, and its name is Inspector Q-0. Every war droid that leaves the line passes under its optic, and anything flawed goes back to the smelter. It is the most dangerous of the three, because it knows where everything is weakest. I need you to go to the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry and destroy Inspector Q-0, then come back to me here.
Good. Destroy Inspector Q-0 in the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, then come back to me here at the Hutlar Outpost for the bounty.
It works in the Core, among the war droids and siege units. It is not always there, so check again later if you do not find it.
You still need to destroy Inspector Q-0. It is in the Core of the Hutlar Droid Foundry, though it is not always on the line. Come back to me when it is scrap.
Mind the scrap, Teb. I will see you later.
What else are you paying for, Teb?
Yes, here are all five cores.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you five Foundry Memory Cores.
Not right now. I break droids, I do not read them.
Why do the build orders matter to you?
How do I get into the Foundry?
What do you want out of the Droid Foundry?
Here are the five Foundry Memory Cores.
I am still pulling them out.
Remind me what you need from the foundry droids.
Yes, all four are scrap and the line is jammed.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Two Smelter Hulks and two Forge Wardens.
Not right now. Kesa's rate will do for me.
How do I tell those two machines apart?
Are they always on the foundry floor?
How do you stop a droid foundry?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need destroyed to stop the line.
What comes after the memory cores?
Yes, the Foundry Overseer is scrap.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy the Foundry Overseer.
Not right now. That is a job for the militia.
Do you want it dead for the scrap?
What will I be walking into?
What is in the Core of the Foundry?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Foundry Overseer.
What comes after the line stoppage?
Yes, Sorter Prime is scrap.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy Sorter Prime.
Not right now. It is not worth my time.
Where exactly is Sorter Prime?
Are any of the foundry droids worth a bounty?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Sorter Prime.
Yes, Foreman RX-12 is scrap.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy Foreman RX-12.
Not right now. I will pass on that one.
Where exactly is Foreman RX-12?
Is there a bounty on the Assembly Line supervisor?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Foreman RX-12.
Yes, Inspector Q-0 is scrap.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy Inspector Q-0.
Not right now. That one can keep inspecting.
Where exactly is Inspector Q-0?
Is there a bounty on whatever inspects the war droids?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Inspector Q-0.
